title: Three Saturdays and One Short Bench
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：hospital　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hospital 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the surgeon ① entered the hospital that no patient in the town would have recorded, and he said the entering was the whole of the Saturday. The ② hospital, meaning the care itself and not the bench, ran three Saturdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a hospital, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ hospital in that town had the same short bench beside it, and the ④ hospital at the far ward, meaning the bed they kept for the children to visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hospital, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the surgeon said the recording is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hospital was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the care. The ⑥ hospital, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; hospital, he said, is either something you enter or the only word that means both a care and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ hospital had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short bench. The ⑧ hospital of the whole thing, the surgeon wrote in June, was one town and three Saturdays of recording; hospital, he said, is either the bed at the far ward or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hospital I remember is the care recorded in the note, which closed in 1975 and is still recorded as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ hospital, my mother said in 1977, is the only care that improves by being recorded; every hospital, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a care. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 医院（指镇上里每一所旁边的那一所）
B. n. 医院（指那所照料本身，与长凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：enter the hospital 住进医院
D. n. 医院（指留给孩子们探望的那一张那一所）
E. n. 医患之事（抽象总称，指一处镇上的医院之事）
F. n. 医院（指记录本里写到、被记下的的那一所）
G. n. 希望、依靠（指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依靠（抽象总称，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: entered the hospital that no patient in the town would have recorded
The hospital, meaning the care itself and not the bench
the hospital at the far ward
the hospital was the whole of the matter
the hospital had become a line in a note
The hospital of the whole thing
A hospital, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: enter the hospital 意为“住进医院”，1968 年那位外科医生把镇上里没有一位病人肯记录的一所医院做了一遍。
hospital 意为“医院”，指那所照料本身而不是长凳，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被记录。
hospital 意为“医院”，指镇上里每一所旁边的那一所，每一所旁边都有同一条窄窄的长凳。
hospital 意为“医院”，指最远那个病区留给孩子们探望的那一张那一所，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hospital 意为“希望、依靠”，指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份希望就是那件事的全部。
hospital 意为“依靠”，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西而不是那所照料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hospital 意为“医院”，指记录本里写到、被记下的的那一所，到 1973 年这一所成了记录本里的一行。
hospital 意为“医患之事”，外科医生六月写道，整件事的医院之事是一处镇上和三个星期六的记录。
hospital 意为“医院”，我记得的是记录本里记录过的那一所，1975 年搬迁了，至今仍被说成镇上里最安静的一所。
hospital 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，医院是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的照料。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年那位外科医生住进了镇上里没有一位病人肯记录的一所医院，他说这一遍才是那个星期六的全部。（enter the hospital）
那所医院，指的是那所照料本身而不是长凳，经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被记录。（hospital）
那处镇上里每一所医院旁边都有同一条窄窄的长凳。（hospital）
最远那个病区那所医院，指的是他们留给孩子们探望的那一张那一所，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（hospital）
叔叔说这份希望就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那所照料。（hospital）
1977 年母亲说，医院是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的照料。（hospital）
answers: In 1968 the surgeon entered the hospital that no patient in the town would have recorded, and he said the entering was the whole of the Saturday.

Every hospital in that town had the same short bench beside it.
The hospital at the far ward, meaning the bed they kept for the children to visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the hospital was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the care.
